source.text:
14 August 2026
Ashcombe & Vale Property Management
Our reference: P406403-9

Dear K Clark,

On behalf of the freeholder we enclose the service charge demand for 5 Clark Ford for the period beginning 25 August 2026. The amount demanded is £1,187.57.

Payment is due by the end of the month. Interest may be charged on late payment under the terms of your lease.

This demand is accompanied by a summary of tenants' rights and obligations under section 21B of the Landlord and Tenant Act 1985. A demand that is not accompanied by the summary is not payable until it is. Costs incurred more than 18 months before a demand cannot normally be recovered.

The budget for the coming year is available on request from our office on 01632 960 877.

Yours sincerely,
Matthew Doherty
Ashcombe & Vale Property Management
